# Real AF3x crosslink prediction

Generated by AF3x inference for AlphaJudge issue #30 from the 4G3Y input.

Input preparation: retain the complete B (226 residues) and C (158 residues)
protein entries, including their supplied MSAs/templates; retain one DSSO link
between B53 and C66; set `modelSeeds` to `[30]` and the job name to
`alphajudge_issue30_4g3y_bc_dsso`. Other input fields are unchanged.

Run with the AF3x revision recorded in `provenance.json`:

```bash
python run_alphafold.py --json_path=input.json --model_dir=MODEL_DIR \
  --output_dir=prediction --norun_data_pipeline \
  --num_recycles=1 --num_diffusion_samples=1
```

The single seed/sample is retained here in AlphaJudge's supported unprefixed
layout. `confidences.json.xz` is a lossless compression of the original complete
confidence JSON. Structure and summary bytes are unchanged. Source hashes,
token counts and inference settings are recorded in `provenance.json`.

This small one-recycle run is a parser/scoring regression fixture, not a
benchmark of AF3x prediction quality. Tests also reorder its original token
matrices and chain summary consistently to exercise ligand-first indexing.
